messages:
laura_cs: Hey all — quick sync on the pilot feedback panel recruitment and renewal-risk scan :wave:

anita_csm: TL;DR: we have 12 pilot accounts that opted into preview. I flagged 3 high-risk renewals (Q3) during intake.

mike_se: Can we get a tight enablement session for the 3 risk accounts? They all need help with infra config and prompt templates.

laura_cs: Agreed. @mike_se can you run a 30m deep-dive for them next week? I can invite. Prefer Tue/Wed mornings PST.

josh_sales: FYI those 3 accounts (NovaFin, Clearmap, ArborBio) requested custom SLAs — renewal likely tied to perf improvements.

emily_prod: From product side we can prioritize a follow-up eval for NovaFin's LLM latency issues. Need repro prompt set + logs.

anita_csm: I'll collect sample prompts — adding a quick ask: can everyone confirm primary contact + best time for session? I'll drop a CSV.

laura_cs: Here's the CSV header I'll paste into the thread:
```
account,contact,name,email,timezone,renewal_date,risk_level,notes
NovaFin,Sam Holden,sam@novafin.com,PST,2026-09-12,high,latency+accuracy
Clearmap,Lina Ortega,lina@clearmap.io,CET,2026-08-05,high,needs quantization tests
ArborBio,Dev Patel,dev@arborbio.org,PST,2026-07-29,high,data privacy scoping
``` 

mike_se: Thanks. I can run a session on Tue 10am PST and Wed 9am PST. I'll prepare a short checklist: infra, batch configs, quant profiles.

josh_sales: I'll prep a one-pager on contract levers we can offer if we hit perf targets (credits, extended trial, SLA pilot).

ops_bot: Reminder: create-calendar-event command invoked by laura_cs for NovaFin session on 2026-06-16T10:00:00-07:00.

anita_csm: Also want to recruit 4 customers for a closed feedback panel to run next month (30min each). Criteria: varied stack + one privacy-sensitive.

emily_prod: I can demo the telemetry dashboard and a compact feedback form (3 Likert Qs + 1 open). Link to draft: https://redwood.prod/feedback-draft

laura_cs: Let's nominate 6 and pick 4. I'll reach out to low-touch cohort this afternoon. @josh_sales can you nudge NovaFin and Clearmap for panel participation? :pray:

josh_sales: On it. I'll ping them in-thread and escalate if no reply within 48h.

anita_csm: Last bit — tagging renewal risk in SF: set custom field pilot_risk = high and add note 'participating in feedback panel, enablement scheduled'.

laura_cs: Perfect. Will update CRM and write a short outreach template. Thanks team — will post session invites when confirmed :white_check_mark:

mike_se: I'll prepare the troubleshooting checklist and a tiny prompt set for reproduction. Sharing shortly.

ops_bot: Event created: NovaFin - Pilot enablement - 2026-06-16 10:00 PST. Organizer: laura_cs.

anita_csm: Closing loop — if anyone finds another at-risk account, DM me. Otherwise I’ll post the outreach template in #cs-templates.

laura_cs: End of thread — moving action items to our tracker.
